title: NVIDIA Q1 FY2023 — financial results
text: NVIDIA reported year-over-year revenue growth of 46% on $8.29 billion of revenue. Data Center and Gaming reached record revenue. GAAP diluted EPS was $0.64, 16% below the prior year; the Arm transaction termination charge affected earnings.

title: NVIDIA Q1 FY2023 — outlook
text: The next quarter revenue outlook was $8.10 billion, plus or minus 2%. The estimate included roughly $500 million in reductions associated with Russia and COVID-related restrictions in China.

title: NVIDIA Q2 FY2023 — financial results
text: NVIDIA reported year-over-year revenue growth of 3% on $6.70 billion of revenue, a slowdown from the previous quarter. Revenue declined 19% sequentially. GAAP diluted EPS fell 72% year over year to $0.26.

title: NVIDIA Q2 FY2023 — business context
text: Data Center revenue reached $3.81 billion, 61% above the prior year. Management described a difficult economic environment and supply-chain transitions. Segment strength and the overall earnings decline provide contrasting evidence.

title: Microsoft Q4 FY2024 — financial results
text: Microsoft reported year-over-year revenue growth of 15% on $64.7 billion of revenue. Operating income rose 15% to $27.9 billion. Net income rose 10% to $22.0 billion, and diluted EPS rose 10% to $2.95.

title: Microsoft FY2024 — annual results
text: For fiscal 2024, Microsoft recorded $245.1 billion in revenue, up 16%. Operating income increased 24% to $109.4 billion and net income increased 22% to $88.1 billion.
